paragraphs.text: I am applying for the {role} position at {company}. My social-sciences coursework and research placement gave me experience preparing data and communicating its practical limits.

At Civic Example Lab, I maintained a service register, reconciled duplicate records and recorded source dates. I also reviewed 24 public reports, comparing their coverage and definitions rather than treating them as directly interchangeable.

My library attendance project paired a Python prototype with a simple prior-week baseline. Held-out error was 18% lower, and documenting the exclusions and assumptions was an important part of the work.
I would bring my experience with Python, spreadsheets, public-source research and short analytical notes to the role.
